lane: Website: account and data deletion page for Google Play (PR-01)
goal: Google Play requires a public web page that explains how to delete a Nilaza account and its data, including without the app. account-delete is ACTIVE on Singapore since 09/11. Add a bilingual page at /vi/account-deletion and /en/account-deletion that states only what the code does, link it from the footer and the privacy page, and leave a clearly marked place for the support mailbox the Owner has not set up yet.
successCriteria: Legal collection accepts slug account-deletion; vi and en pages render through the existing legal route.

The page describes the in-app path, what is deleted (account, profile, birth profile, journal, chats, readings, AI traces, usage events, generation jobs, waitlist entry with the same email), what is kept (safety outcome without text; a hashed deletion record removed 90 days after completion), and does not promise a time it cannot verify.
The page says the support mailbox is being set up and will be listed before testing opens; no invented address.
Footer and privacy pages link to it.
astro check passes; the web build passes if it can run locally.
untouchedSurfaces: No deploy of the website (Owner runs the staging deploy).
In-app delete stays hidden (accountDeleteLive=false) until the app points to Singapore.
No mailbox is created; the Owner provides it.
